categories.main_business_segments: The company operates two primary business segments: (1) Motion Control Products - including motion controllers and motion control modules for electric two/three-wheeled vehicles, electric tools, and consumer electronics; (2) Power Chips - including wafers, packaged products, and related semiconductor components. The company has integrated these segments to create a vertically integrated business model combining upstream power chip design with downstream motion control product applications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs Fabless design model for power chips, utilizing advanced semiconductor technologies including Trench-MOSFET, SGT-MOSFET (Shielded Gate Trench), and SJ-MOSFET (Super Junction) product lines. For motion control products, the company uses self-developed software and hardware integration with vector frequency conversion control schemes. Manufacturing includes self-production for motion controllers using SMT (Surface Mount Technology) and automated assembly lines, while power chips utilize foundry partnerships with leading wafer manufacturers like Huahong Semiconductor and China Huarong Microelectronics.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are leading electric two/three-wheeled vehicle manufacturers. The company also serves markets in electric tools, consumer electronics, and household appliances. End markets include electric bicycles, electric light motorcycles, electric motorcycles, and electric three-wheeled vehicles. Geographic customer concentration shows significant presence in East China (58.60% of revenue), South China (22.12%), and North China (15.10%).
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in mainland China with headquarters and main operations in Zhangjiagang, Jiangsu Province. It has established subsidiaries in Suzhou and maintains sales offices across major regions including East China, South China, and North China. The company's operations are concentrated in the Yangtze River Delta region with manufacturing facilities in Zhangjiagang and Suzhou.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates across multiple supply chain positions: (1) Upstream - as a power chip design company (Fabless model) working with foundry partners; (2) Midstream - as a semiconductor packaging and testing service user; (3) Downstream - as a motion control product manufacturer serving electric vehicle OEMs. The company is building vertical integration through its new packaging and testing facility to move upstream in the power chip value chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include: (1) Expanding power chip product lines across voltage ranges (12V-200V+) and developing IGBT products; (2) Developing next-generation motion control platforms for electric vehicles with enhanced intelligence and higher power ratings; (3) Implementing vertical integration through in-house packaging and testing capabilities; (4) Expanding into new application domains including energy storage, new energy vehicles, and industrial applications; (5) Strengthening R&D team with 118 personnel (21.18% of workforce) and increasing R&D investment to 8.11% of revenue.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through product sales using a direct sales model for motion control products (98.06% of sales) and a mixed direct/distributor model for power chips. Revenue is recognized when customers obtain control of goods, typically upon delivery and customer acceptance. The company operates on a make-to-order basis for customized motion controllers while maintaining some inventory for power chips. Payment terms vary by customer type with major OEM customers typically on 30-90 day terms.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic manufacturer of electric two/three-wheeled vehicle motion control products with significant market share among top-tier vehicle manufacturers. In the power chip sector, the company competes in a fragmented market with approximately 2,000 industry participants. The company differentiates through vertical integration, combining upstream chip design with downstream application expertise. Key competitive advantages include established relationships with major vehicle OEMs, proprietary chip designs optimized for motion control applications, and integrated solutions reducing customer development costs.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-sized semiconductor and motion control manufacturer with 2024 revenue of RMB 330.25 million (down 26.52% YoY from RMB 449.45 million in 2023). Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 37.05 million (down 55.57% YoY). Total assets reached RMB 1.691 billion with shareholders' equity of RMB 1.610 billion. The company experienced significant revenue decline in 2024 due to electric vehicle market regulatory challenges and increased competition, though maintains strong balance sheet with substantial cash reserves and minimal debt.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company's core value proposition centers on: (1) Vertical Integration - unique combination of upstream power chip design with downstream motion control expertise enabling optimized, cost-effective solutions; (2) Application-Specific Optimization - power chips designed specifically for motion control applications rather than generic designs; (3) Comprehensive Solutions - providing complete control solutions from chip to finished controller reducing customer development burden; (4) Quality and Reliability - established track record with leading OEMs; (5) Innovation - continuous development of next-generation platforms with enhanced performance and intelligence. The company emphasizes technical leadership in motion control and power semiconductor design tailored to electric vehicle applications.
